text:
maria: FYI a big customer (AcmeApps) reports EU clients getting routed to us-east, ~300-500ms extra latency and occasional 401s. CS flagged as P0.
support-bot: Ticket INC-2026-342 created and linked. :rotating_light:
ben: Any sample request ids or traces to repro?
maria: They provided req id req_0a9f3c (2026-03-14T09:12:21Z). They assert they send header 'X-Region-Hint: eu-west-1' but gateway ends up forwarding to us-east-1.
leo: Can we get raw ingress headers and Envoy trace for that req id?
maria: Customer-supplied truncated headers below:
```:method: POST
:authority: api.redwood.ai
x-region-hint: eu-west-1
authorization: Bearer <token>
user-agent: acme-client/2.3.1
```
Response contained 'via: us-east-gw' and 'x-auth-error: token-mismatch' in body.
andrew: That smells like header being removed or rewritten before route matching. Note: edge routing rules were changed yesterday (rollout 2026-03-13 22:30 UTC) touching fallback policies.
leah: Routing analytics show a small spike in cross-region handoffs exactly after that rollout. About 6-8% of /v1/generate calls from EU misrouted to us-east in a 4m window.
ben: Repro locally? try curl that sets the region hint and echo the upstream headers.
maria: Customer repro steps (intermittent): 1) curl -v -H "X-Region-Hint: eu-west-1" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 2) check x-upstream-region and x-auth-error. When it fails they see x-upstream-region: us-east-1 + 401.
leo: I ran the loop from an EU test VM (30 requests) and saw 2 failures where upstream was us-east.
```
for i in {1..30}; do curl -s -D - -H "X-Region-Hint: eu-west-1" https://staging-api.redwood.ai/echo | grep x-upstream-region; done
```
Failed cases show the header missing at the upstream.
andrew: Hypothesis: L7 matcher expects header but somewhere (CDN/edge) it's being normalized/dropped. We pushed a VHost rewrite for api.redwood.ai recently.
maria: Customer also reports billing anomalies — tokens charged to wrong region account. Finance escalated.
leah: Billing follows upstream region, so this explains the mischarged tokens. We need to stop leakage immediately.
ben: Short-term mitigations: rollback CDN header whitelist or add IP/CIDR-based pinning for AcmeApps; also consider patch to matcher to be case-insensitive for X-Region-Hint.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline queued: edge-hotfix/prefer-region-hint (awaiting approval).
andrew: Before patching, capture Envoy access log and x-envoy-original-path / attempt headers for failing reqs. Also check any routing trace headers.
leo: Enabled debug for envoy/router on EU ingress for 10m. Found in logs for req_0a9f3c:
```
[2026-03-14T09:12:21Z] req_0a9f3c matched virtual_host: api.redwood.ai (alias: api-edge) route: /v1/generate -> cluster: gw-us-east weight 100 ; reason: header_match FAILED -> fell back to default cluster
```
ben: Route fell back because the header match failed — header must have been absent at match time.
maria: Could be the CDN forwarding whitelist. We changed CDN forwarding rules at 2026-03-13 22:28 UTC; maybe some nodes encoded headers differently (case-sensitivity).
andrew: I checked the CDN config audit: there was a brief window where newer nodes ran a config variant that omitted lower-case x-* headers due to an encoding bug. Fleet had mixed configs for ~4 minutes.
leah: That would explain intermittent nature. Some requests hit nodes that dropped X-Region-Hint.
ben: Root cause likely: CDN forward whitelist regression + route matcher expecting lowercase header -> intermittent fallbacks to default cluster (us-east).
maria: Immediate actions proposed:
- Rollback CDN whitelist to previous working config (canary then full)
- Apply short-term IP/CIDR routing pin for AcmeApps to prefer eu-west
- Hotfix edge matcher to tolerate header case and prefer region-hint earlier
- Prepare billing refund for affected tokens
andrew: I approve CDN rollback. ops-bot, run the CDN-whitelist-rollback playbook.
ops-bot: Starting runbook CDN-whitelist-rollback -> canary -> target 10% nodes now.
leo: Also kicking off a log scan to count recent /v1/generate -> gw-us-east matches to estimate scope:
```
grep "route: /v1/generate -> cluster: gw-us-east" /var/log/envoy/* | wc -l
```
maria: Customer notified: investigating, ETA ~45m for rollback, hotfix 2-3h.
ben: After rollback, add e2e test against staging CDN validating both 'X-Region-Hint' and 'x-region-hint' capitalizations.
andrew: Add alert: ratio of requests where region-hint present but upstream region != hinted region > 1% -> page eng-sre.
leah: I'll compute refund; finance will approve.

-- 22 minutes later --

ops-bot: CDN-whitelist-rollback progressed to 100% nodes. Canaries green.
leo: Post-rollback curl loop 100x from EU VM: 0 failures, always x-upstream-region: eu-west-1.
ben: Hotfix PR edge/ignore-header-case-and-prefer-region-hint #4823 opened with unit tests.
andrew: Scheduling controlled deploy to edge in 30m.
maria: Customer updated: "Stable now, latency back to baseline, no 401s in 45m." :tada:
leah: Billing impact estimate: ~14k tokens misbilled. Finance ok with refund; opening billing ticket.
ben: Postmortem owners: andrew (eng-runtime), leo (eng-sre), leah (finance/support), maria (CS).
maria: We'll publish short postmortem linking runbook and PRs. Closing thread when postmortem done.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-342 -> resolved. Postmortem requested.
maria: Thanks team. :heart:
